agent_answer:

This is a **systemic pattern**, not an isolated incident. Late deliveries span October 2025 through February 2026 with no improvement trend — if anything, recent POs (Jan–Feb 2026) show the largest slippages (+3 and +4 days). The 3.2 rating reflects this history.

**Recommendation:** Given the 76% late rate and worsening trend, consider reducing reliance on SUP-002 for time-sensitive stock, always buffer their lead time by at least 2 days when planning reorders, and evaluate whether a higher-rated supplier offers the same products (SP-004, SP-005).
